walk.summary:
Row N re-walk on 9eb10528: all 13 steps and 8 items were walked on a fresh encrypted store, locked at boot, in airplane mode throughout.

**Steps:** N1–N11 pass, including the N11 locale step (fr, ar, zh, ja), which failed on the previous walk. N12 and N13 are not-measurable-here because they need the maintainer's real install. The N13 stand-in (a store seeded by the pre-S8 code, served by the fixed build) re-indexed 111 articles, brought the Arabic and Chinese search totals to parity, and re-indexed 0 on a second run.

**Items:** 7 of 8 are fixed; N-4 is still present.
- **Fixed:** N-1, N-2 (every analysis caveat is keyed in all locales), N-3 (the P1: the Counts chart now says 22 mentions, not 22 articles), N-5, N-6, N-7 (concept-map labels are 11–20 px at 375 px) and N-8 (Home briefing prose in the UI language).
- **N-4 still present:** everything in the analysis window now repaints on a live language switch (Articles, per-form counts, Sentiment, Trend). The Settings → Advanced → Diagnostics re-index status line does not: after a live fr→ar switch it stays French at 10 s, until the Diagnostics fold is closed and reopened. The one oo:langchange listener (src/static/app-boot.js) has no call that redraws the job lines.

**Clean run:** no page errors, console errors, HTTP errors ≥ 400, off-loopback requests or junk tokens. No consent popup appeared, and "Go online" was never pressed. The worktree was untouched, and both of my servers were stopped by PID. Five incidental observations are listed separately.

items.root_cause:
src/static/app-diagnostics.js:183: _watchJobLine writes the line once, with st.textContent = render(s, report, t). Its loop exits at :189 once the job is not running, or when it is paused and the fold is closed, so nothing draws it again.

The only way back in is the Diagnostics fold's toggle handler: src/static/app-boot.js:827-829, which calls watchDiagnosticsJobs at app-diagnostics.js:202.

The one oo:langchange listener (src/static/app-boot.js:41-365) has no entry for the three job lines (#reindex-all-status, #kw-fold-status, #fts-reindex-status). Neither do the other oo:langchange listeners (app-backup.js:30 and :3580, app-settings.js:263).

The composed 'Label: n · …' sentence matches no English key, so the i18n DOM walker cannot repaint it either. The B24 N-4 commits (1d7ff310, ddbdb9db) touched only the analysis window; app-diagnostics.js is not in either diff.
items.suggested_fix:
Two parts, following the listener's rule of redrawing from what was last drawn and never fetching:

1. In _watchJobLine, keep the last (s, report, render, st) per key in a module map, for example _jobLast[key], written wherever it sets st.textContent.
2. Add repaintDiagnosticsJobsFromCache(). It re-runs render(s, report, OOI18N.t) into each st that has a retained reading, and applies the same quietIdle rule as :183. Register it in the app-boot.js oo:langchange listener with the usual try/typeof guard.

The simpler alternative, calling watchDiagnosticsJobs() when the fold is open, costs three loopback reads per switch. The listener's comments say a switch never fetches, so the cached repaint is the better fit.
